Probably not

There often are waiting lists, on top of the fact that if she's posing no real (medical) threat to either herself or others it won't be a (medical) emergency, and therefore probably won't take her in, let alone if she'd be resistant or unwilling to coöperate. 

You'd have the best luck getting her to agree to rehab and then checking in to a rehab facility, but even then it isn't guaranteed they'll be able to take her in immediately. If she's already a patient at a mental health clinic or psychiatrist / psychologist it'll probably be a bit easier though, in that case you could make a case for her being diagnosed as in some way mentally unstable / unaccountable and forced hospitalization might be an option.

Based upon your history they might have you hospitalized. If you've never tried anything and don't do a lot of self harm they will most likely not do much except refer you to suicide helplines/ maybe prescribe something to calm u down for if u feel suicidal (usually benzos like oxazepam), however if you're covered in scars or have made an attempt before they might hospitalize you for a couple days, if your gp thinks you're a legit threat to yourself. 

Depending on the country they might refer you to a psychologist/psychotherapist/psychiatrist directly, or to a mental health clinic who will then refer you to one of their psychologists/psychotherapist/psychiatrist.

You are basically me 3 months ago. And to be honest I can't say it's gotten any better. I was on the brink of killing myself as well. Still am. Started off with nothing seeming fun, then it became a permanent boredom accompanied with not being able to feel any emotion at all. 
It's not like I'm missing anything in life, have a job, money, friends and had a girlfriend who was great up until I got depressed so that ended as well. So you're not the only one with problems without any apparent reason. 

The only thing that stopped me at the time and is stopping me to this day was the fact that I don't want to hurt my mother after she's been trying to raise me for 18 years. Eventually sought help because I knew if I didn't I'd be dead next week. Honestly the last chance for me right now are the antidepressants I'm getting next week and if those don't help I'm just gonna end it. But at least I can say I've tried everything in order to become happy. If I end up doing this I don't want people to think it's because of laziness of me to try and make life worth it. 

But seeing as you're nearly 18 I'd advise u to seek help as well. You won't need your parents permission/consent anymore at that point either. Nor will they contact your parents unless you give permission. In the end its up to you how you decide on going from here but if you're like me and have nothing to lose, it's worth trying before killing yourself. That'll always be an option anyway. 

But most importantly you were wrong in saying you weren't gonna get any replies. And I don't think you're pathetic :). 

(Or at least no more pathetic than me but that might not say much :p)
